description: Main source file for a Flutter-based note-taking app, defining UI components, data models, state management, local storage, and API interactions for note creation, summarization, and display.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Data model representing a note, including serialization and deserialization methods.

classes.name: NotesHomePage
classes.description: Main page widget managing note display and user interactions.

classes.name: _NotesHomePageState
classes.description: State class for NotesHomePage managing app state, logic, and UI updates.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point, initializes Flutter bindings and loads environment variables.

methods.name: _loadNotes
methods.description: Loads notes from local storage and updates state.

methods.name: _saveNotesLocally
methods.description: Saves current notes list to local storage.

methods.name: _localSummarize
methods.description: Provides a fallback local method to generate a note summary when backend summarization fails.

methods.name: summarizeAndSave
methods.description: Generates a summary (via backend or fallback), then saves the note locally and attempts to persist it to backend.

methods.name: _buildForm
methods.description: Builds the input form UI with text fields and save button.

methods.name: _buildEmpty
methods.description: Displays a placeholder message when no notes are available.

methods.name: _buildList
methods.description: Builds the list view of saved notes.
